title: Your ordinary day as a serious documentary
summary: Sit in a chair or do one dull task while a slow, serious documentary voice narrates it like a big life moment. AI writes the script and reads it.
why: An Instagram Reels trend roundup updated in October 2026 lists a documentary-style chair-sit format: a slow documentary score over very ordinary narration, crossing over from TikTok to Reels.
steps: Pick one boring moment: sitting down with a coffee, choosing a snack, folding laundry, opening the shop in the morning.
Use the main prompt to get a 20 to 30 second narration in a calm, serious documentary tone.
Paste the script into an AI voice tool and choose a low, slow narrator voice. Or read it yourself, very seriously.
Film the moment in one take, add soft piano or strings from your editor's free music, and lay the voice on top.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Write a 25-second narration for a short video in the tone of a slow, serious nature documentary. The subject is me doing something very ordinary: [sitting down in my favourite chair after work]. Treat it like a rare, important event. Use short sentences, long pauses marked with "...", and one gentle joke near the end. Keep it kind and family-friendly. No real people's names, no brand names and no famous narrator impressions.

prompts.label: Variation: your pet
prompts.text: Write a 20-second documentary-style narration about my [cat] doing something very normal: [staring at an empty food bowl]. Describe it like a wildlife film, with calm wonder and a dry, funny final line. Add [pause] where the voice should stop for a beat. Keep it under 70 words.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run a [type of business, for example: small bakery in Halifax]. Write a 30-second documentary-style narration of an ordinary morning task, like [pulling the first tray of muffins out of the oven]. Make it calm, warm and a little funny, and end with one honest line about what we make. No made-up awards, reviews or customer numbers, and no prices.

tips: The flatter and slower the voice, the funnier it gets. Don't rush the pauses.
Keep the camera still. One wide shot makes it feel like real wildlife footage.
Pick a stock AI voice or your own. Don't clone anyone else's voice.
Add captions. Lots of people watch with the sound off.
